discord.title: Discord Rich Presence
discord.description: Show your friends what you're playing, requires Discord to be running.

videoFirst.title: Music videos first
videoFirst.description: Open video songs in Watch. Audio tracks still use the music player.

keepWatching.title: Keep watching view
keepWatching.description: Keep the watching layout on track changes and return from automatic Picture-in-Picture. Manual Picture-in-Picture stays open.

flowImport.title: Flow playlist files (TIDAL import)
flowImport.description: Choose Flow playlist JSON files or ZIP archives. Playlists with existing names are skipped. Each playlist keeps its original track order.
flowImport.libraryFailed: Could not read the existing library. No playlists were saved. Try again.

reasons.invalidPlaylist: Failed: missing playlist name or videos array
reasons.emptyZip: Failed: ZIP contains no JSON files
reasons.saveFailed: Failed: library could not be saved
